original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated stressed system survives ten abrupt AC interruptions at 40C/+5% rails, logs each drop correctly and returns with all devices healthy.
original_method: Inventory full hardware; approve bounded CPU/DIMM/storage stress and non-destructive targets; calibrate environment/power fixture; preserve log baseline; for each cycle reach five-minute load/steady state, timestamp hard AC loss, hold verified off dwell, restore AC, wait for BMC/host readiness, enumerate devices and capture expected power-loss events; stop on corruption/boot loop/device loss; after ten cycles restore nominal environment and verify data/system health.
manual_activity: Operator controls stress/environment and physically interrupts/restores AC for all ten cycles.
agent_execution_scope: No physical control or PASS claim

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly manual; software cannot safely substitute for abrupt physical AC removal.

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full population, five-minute stress, ten drops, 40C/+5% and recovery checks retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a ten-cycle transaction ledger joining pre-drop steady load, power timestamps, expected loss events, boot/inventory and data integrity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe stress targets, controlled timing, per-cycle proof and corruption recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Normal shutdown/power cycling cannot replace abrupt loaded AC-loss coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Abrupt loss during storage writes can corrupt data; repeated inrush and thermal margin stress power hardware.
